overall.aggregation: mean of per-JSONL scores, official scorer

caveats: This is a small, reused development set, not an independent generalization test.
Source image fallbacks are not recognized LaTeX and must not be counted as successful math OCR.
These results cover scale 2.5 with source guards enabled; other configurations are not evaluated here.
Timing is not a controlled speed comparison.

rerun_0_4_0.note: Re-run with the 0.4.0 package layout (Docling engine removed, same PaddleOCR-VL pipeline): identical scores in every category.

runtime_source_note: runtime_source_sha256 paths refer to the pre-0.4.0 layout (tool/pdf_to_md.py, tool/paddle_worker.py) that produced the original run.
